description:
£145 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this spacious six-bedroom upper maisonette, ideally situated on Ashleigh Grove in the sought-after area of West Jesmond.

Perfectly positioned for student living, the property is conveniently located close to local amenities, shops and West Jesmond Metro Station, providing excellent transport links to both Newcastle University and Northumbria University.

Recently refurbished in parts and presented to a high standard throughout, the property offers well-proportioned accommodation, making it an ideal choice for a group of students looking for a comfortable and conveniently located home.

Further benefits include double glazing, gas combination boiler central heating and a private rear yard.

Don't miss out on this fantastic student property! Contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team to arrange your viewing.
